Batchwise

Privacy policy

Last updated 2 November 2026

Batchwise is an app that coaching institutes, schools and colleges use to run attendance, fees, tests and parent updates. This policy explains what personal data the app holds, why, who can see it, how long it is kept and how you can exercise your rights under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act).

Who is responsible

Your institute decides what data to collect and why, so it is the Data Fiduciary for your data. [BUSINESS NAME] ("we"), which provides Batchwise, processes the data only on your institute's instructions, as its Data Processor.

Each institute's data is kept in its own separate database. We do not sell personal data, show advertising, or use it for any purpose of our own.

What data the app holds

  • Identity and contact: name, mobile number, email, and for students the parent's or guardian's name and mobile number.
  • Enrolment: batch or class, roll number, and for staff, subjects and qualifications.
  • Attendance: which classes a student attended, and when.
  • Tests and results: marks, ranks and published results.
  • Fees: fee plan, instalments, payments, receipts and the payment reference (for example a UPI transaction number). The app never stores card or bank details.
  • Enquiries: details of people who asked about joining, recorded by the institute.
  • Files you upload, such as assignment submissions or an ID photo.
  • Private notes that teachers keep about a student's progress, visible only to staff.
  • Technical data: a notification token for your device and basic error logs.

Why it is used

Only to run your institute: taking attendance, managing fees and receipts, publishing results, sending notices, and keeping parents informed about attendance, fees and results. The legal basis is your consent, given to your institute when you enrol, and the institute's legitimate uses permitted by the DPDP Act.

Children

Many students are under 18. Under the DPDP Act, the institute must obtain verifiable consent from a parent or guardian before processing a child's data. The app does not track children's behaviour or show them targeted advertising.

Who can see it

  • Students see their own records. Teachers see what they need for their classes. Institute administrators see everything for their institute.
  • Parents receive messages about their own child by WhatsApp, if the institute turns this on.
  • Service providers who process data for us, under contract and only to provide the service: Google Cloud / Firebase (hosting, sign-in and storage, in Mumbai, India); Meta (WhatsApp messages, only if the institute connects WhatsApp); Razorpay (online fee payments, only if the institute connects it).
  • Authorities, only when Indian law requires it.

How long it is kept

Data is kept while you are enrolled or employed at the institute and for as long afterwards as the institute needs it for its records. Fee and payment records may have to be kept for the period tax law requires. When data is no longer needed it is deleted. Backups are kept for up to 30 days and then overwritten.

Your rights

You can ask to see a summary of your data, to correct or complete it, or to have it erased, and you can withdraw your consent. You can also nominate someone to exercise these rights for you if you die or become unable to.

To delete your account, open Profile, then Request account deletion, or see the account deletion page. For anything else, contact your institute's office first. If you are not satisfied, write to our Grievance Officer below. We respond within 30 days.

If your complaint is not resolved, you may complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

Security

Data is encrypted in transit and at rest by Google Cloud. Access is limited by role, every account needs a password, and payment and messaging keys are stored where no app user can read them. If a breach affects your data, we will help your institute inform you and the Data Protection Board as the law requires.

Contact and grievances

Grievance Officer: [GRIEVANCE OFFICER NAME], [BUSINESS NAME], [REGISTERED ADDRESS]. Email: [CONTACT EMAIL].

Changes

We will update this policy when the app or the law changes, and show the new date at the top. Significant changes will be announced in the app.
